data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'helianore', meaning 'shining light' or 'sunny'. In Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eleanore usually hope their child will grow to embody light, sunny and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.spiritual_significance: Eleanore is a name that embodies the light of the sun and the hope it brings. It is a reminder that even in the darkest of times, the light of hope and faith can guide and inspire us. Overall, Eleanore is a name that carries a strong spiritual significance, representing the light of hope and faith in a world that can sometimes seem dark and uncertain.
